activities.name: Resize
activities.whenToUse: Use to resize a local input image to an output file through the media helper. Select dimensions or TargetLongest, quality and overwrite policy in Config; Density is accepted but currently unused by final magick arguments. This reads and can write local files.

properties.description: Configure image resize Density.
properties.whenToUse: Set rendering density for Resize when the default 72 is unsuitable; the current helper passes Density to a nested resize call, but the final magick argument list does not use it.

properties.description: Configure image resize InputFullPath.
properties.whenToUse: Supply an existing local image file to resize. The helper checks that the source file exists before processing.

properties.description: Configure image resize OutputFullPath.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the destination file for resized output. The helper creates or overwrites it according to Config.Overwrite.

properties.description: Configure image resize Overwrite.
properties.whenToUse: Set true only when an existing output file may be replaced. Omit or false to skip processing when OutputFullPath already exists.

properties.description: Configure image resize Quality.
properties.whenToUse: Set image output quality for Resize when the default 80 is unsuitable.

properties.description: Configure image resize TargetHeight.
properties.whenToUse: Set a target image height when resizing by explicit dimensions; omit or zero when height should be inferred from width or TargetLongest.

properties.description: Configure image resize TargetLongest.
properties.whenToUse: Set the desired longest edge when resize dimensions should follow source orientation. A positive value chooses width or height before explicit resize arguments.

properties.description: Configure image resize TargetWidth.
properties.whenToUse: Set a target image width when resizing by explicit dimensions; omit or zero when width should be inferred from height or TargetLongest.

properties.description: Check for an explicit utility virtual path before synthesizing a top-level path.
properties.whenToUse: The mapped wrapper checks whether this has a Result before optional Container/Resource synthesis. It does not copy Config.VirtualPath into top-level VirtualPath; the media helper uses its own image Config paths.

properties.description: Build the generated utility virtual path when no explicit path is resolved.
properties.whenToUse: When Config.VirtualPath has no Result, supply Container with Resource if the mapped wrapper should synthesize a top-level utility VirtualPath. Resize file paths remain Config.InputFullPath/OutputFullPath.

properties.description: Read the image-operation path passed to the selected helper.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the image-operation Path forwarded to the selected Resize helper when its route uses it; source/destination files are configured separately.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the image plan.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Phase when the concrete media adapter clones the image Plan to preserve conduction context.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the image plan.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Plan when the concrete media adapter clones the image Plan to preserve conduction context.

properties.description: Build the generated utility virtual path when no explicit path is resolved.
properties.whenToUse: When Config.VirtualPath has no Result, supply Resource with Container to synthesize a top-level utility VirtualPath; this does not replace the configured image file paths.

result.description: When Config supplies source/target/options; existing/skip/overwrite branches are helper-controlled; ImageMagick helper reports success.
When Config supplies source/target/options; existing/skip/overwrite branches are helper-controlled; target already exists and Overwrite=false; successful skip.

resultNotes: Utility_Media: True does not prove dimensions, pixels, placement, opacity or byte change; inspect output independently

activities.name: Inspect
activities.whenToUse: Use to read bytes and a hash from an absolute local file without writing output. The trusted Utility_Media adapter must supply four bounded Inspect limits even in hash-only mode. Optionally set DecodePixels true for a verified single-frame PNG/GIF and zero-based samples; unsupported formats or frames fail before pixel output.
activities.description: Read actual local file bytes and optionally bounded lossless raster pixels without writing output.

properties.description: Required existing local file path; hash-only accepts arbitrary bytes including zero length.
properties.whenToUse: Supply an existing absolute local file path; relative, UNC and network-drive paths are rejected. Hash-only mode accepts arbitrary bytes, including a zero-length file.

properties.description: Optional native Boolean, default false; true decodes only verified single-frame PNG/GIF.
properties.whenToUse: Set native Boolean true only when bounded pixel decoding of a supported single-frame PNG/GIF is needed. Omit or false for hash/byte facts without decoding.

properties.description: Native integral zero-based pixel X in the decoded image; requires DecodePixels=true.
properties.whenToUse: When DecodePixels is true, supply a native integral zero-based X coordinate for each requested sample within the decoded image.

properties.description: Native integral zero-based pixel Y in the decoded image; requires DecodePixels=true.
properties.whenToUse: When DecodePixels is true, supply a native integral zero-based Y coordinate for each requested sample within the decoded image.

result.description: Absolute local path whose bytes were read; not an echoed proof of content.
Measured raw file byte count, including zero.
Uppercase SHA-256 of the actual raw file bytes.
Only with DecodePixels=true: decoded first-frame width after single-frame validation.
Only with DecodePixels=true: decoded first-frame height after single-frame validation.
Only with DecodePixels=true: normalized sRGBA8 output, not source-file metadata.
Only with DecodePixels=true: selected X,Y and straight-alpha R,G,B,A integer channels (0–255).

resultNotes: Failure has no public Result; decode rejects unsupported/multiple frames, invalid points and detected input changes. Hash-only mode does not prove pixel placement.

activities.name: Overlay
activities.whenToUse: Use to compose one or more local overlay images onto an input image and write OutputFullPath. Prefer Config.Overlays entries for multiple images; the legacy single-overlay fields are used when filtering Config.Overlays leaves no non-null entries. Overwrite controls an existing output.

properties.description: Configure image overlay InputFullPath.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the existing base image file for Overlay.

properties.description: Configure the legacy single overlay Location.
properties.whenToUse: For the legacy single-overlay form, select where the overlay is placed. Use per-entry Location when Config.Overlays is supplied.

properties.description: Configure the legacy single overlay Opacity.
properties.whenToUse: For the legacy single-overlay form, set opacity from 0 to 100; omit to use 100. Use per-entry Opacity for Config.Overlays.

properties.description: Configure image overlay OutputFullPath.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the local file destination for the composed image. Overwrite policy applies if it already exists.

properties.description: Configure the legacy single overlay OverlayFullPath.
properties.whenToUse: For the legacy single-overlay form, supply the overlay image file. Use per-entry OverlayFullPath when Config.Overlays is supplied.

properties.description: Configure image overlay Overlays.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a collection of overlay entries for multi-image composition. The helper filters null entries; if at least one remains, it uses those entries instead of legacy single-overlay fields.

properties.description: Configure a supplied overlay entry Location.
properties.whenToUse: For each supplied overlay entry, choose a supported placement location; omission uses Center.

properties.description: Configure a supplied overlay entry Opacity.
properties.whenToUse: For each supplied overlay entry, set opacity from 0 to 100; omission uses 100.

properties.description: Configure a supplied overlay entry OverlayFullPath.
properties.whenToUse: For each supplied overlay entry, provide the existing overlay image file path.

properties.description: Configure a supplied overlay entry ResizeX.
properties.whenToUse: For each overlay entry, set horizontal resize pixels when resizing that overlay; both ResizeX and ResizeY must be positive for that resize branch.

properties.description: Configure a supplied overlay entry ResizeY.
properties.whenToUse: For each overlay entry, set vertical resize pixels when resizing that overlay; both ResizeX and ResizeY must be positive for that resize branch.

properties.description: Configure image overlay Overwrite.
properties.whenToUse: Set true only when the existing OutputFullPath may be replaced. Omit or false to skip composition when output already exists.

properties.description: Configure the legacy single overlay ResizeX.
properties.whenToUse: For the legacy single-overlay form, set horizontal resize pixels with positive ResizeY when resizing that overlay.

properties.description: Configure the legacy single overlay ResizeY.
properties.whenToUse: For the legacy single-overlay form, set vertical resize pixels with positive ResizeX when resizing that overlay.

properties.description: Check for an explicit utility virtual path before synthesizing a top-level path.
properties.whenToUse: The mapped wrapper checks this before optional Container/Resource synthesis but does not copy it to top-level VirtualPath. Overlay image files come from Config.InputFullPath/OutputFullPath/Overlays.

properties.description: Build the generated utility virtual path when no explicit path is resolved.
properties.whenToUse: When Config.VirtualPath has no Result, supply Container with Resource to synthesize a top-level utility VirtualPath; image files remain configured in Overlay Config.

properties.description: Read the image-operation path passed to the selected helper.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the image-operation Path forwarded to the selected Overlay helper when used; base, overlay and output files are separate Config paths.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the image plan.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Phase when concrete media code clones the overlay Plan to preserve conduction context.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning the image plan.
properties.whenToUse: Retain incoming parent Plan when concrete media code clones the overlay Plan to preserve conduction context.

properties.description: Build the generated utility virtual path when no explicit path is resolved.
properties.whenToUse: When Config.VirtualPath has no Result, supply Resource with Container to synthesize top-level utility VirtualPath; this does not set image file paths.

result.description: When Config supplies source/target/options; existing/skip/overwrite branches are helper-controlled; ImageMagick helper reports success.
When Config supplies source/target/options; existing/skip/overwrite branches are helper-controlled; target already exists and Overwrite=false; successful skip.

resultNotes: Utility_Media: True does not prove dimensions, pixels, placement, opacity or byte change; inspect output independently
